questions.body_en:
A new operation is defined as

m ※ n = (m + n) ÷ 2

Find the value of 3 ※ (6 ※ 8).

hint_steps_en: The operation m ※ n gives the average: (m + n) ÷ 2.
First evaluate the inner bracket: 6 ※ 8 = (6 + 8) ÷ 2 = 7.
Then evaluate 3 ※ 7 = (3 + 7) ÷ 2 = 5.
The answer is 5, which is C.

Ben: I do not know how to drive.

hint_steps_en: Ben says he can't drive; Chris says the same about Ben — they make identical claims.

Since both can't be the sole truth-teller, both must be LYING → Ben CAN drive.
Adrian is the sole truth-teller (has a license). Both Adrian and Ben can drive — answer A.

hint_steps_en: To maximise children, minimise each child's share — give most children just 2 apples.
One child must get 3. Remaining apples = 100 − 3 = 97.
97 ÷ 2 = 48 remainder 1 → 48 children get 2 apples each (96 apples), 1 leftover.
Give the extra 1 apple to the 3-apple child (now has 4, still fair with others having 2).
Total children = 1 + 48 = 49. The answer is C.

Satu anak harus mendapat 3. Apel yang tersisa = 100 − 3 = 97.
97 ÷ 2 = 48 sisa 1 → 48 anak mendapat 2 apel masing-masing (96 apel), 1 tersisa.
Berikan 1 apel sisa ke anak dengan 3 apel (sekarang memiliki 4, tetap adil dengan yang lain mendapat 2).

questions.body_en:
In Mathematics,

1² = 1 × 1 = 1
2² = 2 × 2 = 4
3² = 3 × 3 = 9
...

It is also observed that

2² = 1² + 3
3² = 2² + 5
4² = 3² + 7
5² = 4² + 9
...

21² = a² + b

Find the value of (a + b).
questions.body_id:

2² = 2 × 2 = 4
3² = 3 × 3 = 9
...

Diamati juga bahwa

2² = 1² + 3
3² = 2² + 5
4² = 3² + 7
5² = 4² + 9
...

21² = a² + b

Temukan nilai (a + b).

highlights.note_en: Pattern: n² = (n−1)² + (2n−1), so a = n−1 and b = 2n−1

questions.body_en:
Mdm Yee has 10 apples to give to her 3 children. Each child must get at least one apple.

How many ways are there to do so?
questions.body_id:
Ibu Yee memiliki 10 apel untuk diberikan kepada 3 anaknya. Setiap anak harus mendapatkan setidaknya satu apel.

Ada berapa cara untuk melakukannya?

highlights.phrase_en: Mdm Yee has 10 apples to give to her 3 children

highlights.note_en: Distribute 10 identical apples to 3 distinct children

highlights.note_en: Each child ≥ 1 apple; substitute yi = xi−1 to get a stars-and-bars problem with y1+y2+y3 = 7

highlights.phrase_en: How many ways are there to do so?

strategy.name_en: Stars and bars with minimum constraint
strategy.name_id: Stars and bars dengan batasan minimum

hint_steps_en: Let x1, x2, x3 be apples for each child; x1+x2+x3=10 with each xi ≥ 1.
Substitute yi = xi−1 (each yi ≥ 0): y1+y2+y3 = 7.
By stars and bars: C(7+2, 2) = C(9,2) = 9×8/2 = 36.
The answer is 36.

Dengan stars and bars: C(7+2, 2) = C(9,2) = 9×8/2 = 36.

questions.body_en:
Megan was walking along a straight road. She met an oncoming car and she asked the driver, "Did you overtake a cyclist just now?"

"Yes, 10 minutes ago," the driver replied.

After walking for another 10 minutes, Megan met the cyclist.

Given that the cyclist's speed was 4 times Megan's walking speed, how many times of Megan's speed was the driver's speed?
questions.body_id:
Megan sedang berjalan di sepanjang jalan lurus. Ia bertemu dengan mobil yang datang dari arah berlawanan dan bertanya kepada pengemudi, "Apakah Anda baru saja mendahului seorang pengendara sepeda?"

"Ya, 10 menit yang lalu," jawab pengemudi.

Setelah berjalan 10 menit lagi, Megan bertemu dengan pengendara sepeda.

Diketahui bahwa kecepatan pengendara sepeda adalah 4 kali kecepatan berjalan Megan, berapa kali kecepatan Megan adalah kecepatan pengemudi?

quantities.value: Let Megan speed=1. At t=−10: car and cyclist both at position P. At t=0: car at 0 (meets Megan), so P=10v (car moved 10v toward Megan).
Cyclist at P−10×4 = 10v−40 (same direction as car)
Megan at 10; cyclist at (10v−40)−40 = 10v−80. Set equal: 10=10v−80 → v=9.

strategy.name_en: Set up relative motion equations
strategy.name_id: Buat persamaan gerak relatif

hint_steps_en: Let Megan's speed = 1 unit. Cyclist speed = 4 units. Driver speed = v units (all in same unit).
Set t=0 as when Megan meets the driver. At t=−10 (10 min earlier), the driver overtook the cyclist at position P.
The driver travels toward Megan: P = 10v. The cyclist (going same way as driver) is at P − 10×4 = 10v − 40 at t=0.
At t=10: Megan is at position 10. Cyclist is at (10v−40) − 10×4 = 10v−80.
They meet: 10 = 10v − 80 → 10v = 90 → v = 9. The answer is 9.
hint_steps_id: Misalkan kecepatan Megan = 1 satuan. Kecepatan pengendara = 4 satuan. Kecepatan pengemudi = v satuan.
Tetapkan t=0 saat Megan bertemu pengemudi. Pada t=−10 (10 menit sebelumnya), pengemudi mendahului pengendara di posisi P.
Pengemudi bergerak menuju Megan: P = 10v. Pengendara (arah sama dengan pengemudi) berada di P − 10×4 = 10v − 40 pada t=0.
Pada t=10: Megan di posisi 10. Pengendara di (10v−40) − 10×4 = 10v−80.
